notes: 2018_00_hr_home.txt is the HR home page: navigation, calendars and contacts; no policy.

Governing document: the Faculty Handbook (2018_01) is the faculty governing document and contains a leave policy (FH 2.13 Leave of Absence at Faculty Member's Request) and FH 2.12 Sabbatical Leave, so The no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply and missing is false. The handbook contains no parental, maternity, childbirth, adoption, sick-leave, vacation, modified-duties or tenure-clock provision.

Population: the handbook contains no tenure policy; professorial faculty (assistant, associate and full professors) hold renewable multi-year appointments (FH 2.5). These are coded as main_campus_tenure_stream (the institution's equivalent of the tenure stream). No appointment-clock extension exists (C7 absent).

FH 2.12 Sabbatical Leave (paid, one term full pay or one year half pay, after three years' service) is for advanced study, research or scholarly growth; a parent could not take it for a birth (checklist §1); not a component.
FH 2.13 (c1) is the only leave for faculty: unpaid, discretionary, for 'medical or compelling personal reasons', no length stated; flagged general_purpose (U1) and so counted in no figure.

Short- and long-term disability (c2-c4) appear only in the 2017-2018 benefits guide, a summary that defers to 'official plan documents that govern the plans' (not saved). Under the rule for governing documents cited but not saved (reader instructions §1) they are coded as stated and flagged cross_reference_not_saved, not summary_only; the handbook does not cover disability benefits.

No statute that gives parental leave is named in any document (FMLA not mentioned); statutes named (ADA, FERPA, 45 CFR 46, HIPAA, USCIS regulations, general anti-discrimination law) are listed under C4 not_components. The FMLA statutory floor applies under U7.
Benefits guide qualifying events (birth, adoption, leave of absence) allow changes to benefit elections only; dependent-care FSA, EAP and life insurance are not leave, pay or protection.

Chain, birth parent: STD 11 weeks (66 2/3%, after an unanchored 14-calendar-day elimination period) → LTD Option A or Option B (in_lieu_of each other, no duration); FH 2.13 unpaid leave (general purpose, unlinked, no length).
Chain, non-birth parent: no component counts for this role; only the general-purpose FH 2.13 unpaid leave (unlinked, no length).

Cited but not saved: the official plan documents for the Short-Term and Long-Term Disability plans; the Summary Plan Description (benefits guide, qualifying events); the HR site's 'Policies (Internal)' and 'Accommodations' pages (HR home navigation, unnamed policies). Other handbook cross-references (Safety Manual, Research Handbook, objectivity policy, graduate policies, academic policies) are unrelated to leave.
